probe:
Private events As String

Private Function Book(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, s As String
    For Each ws In wb.Worksheets
        s = s & "," & ws.Name & IIf(ws.Visible = xlSheetVisible, "", "(hidden)")
    Next
    Book = wb.Name & "|" & wb.FileFormat & "|" & wb.Saved & "|" & wb.Worksheets.Count & "|" & Mid$(s, 2) & "|" & _
        wb.ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & ActiveWorkbook.Name
End Function

Public Function Probe(name As String, path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets(1).Name = "Data"
    wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = "data": wb.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Value = 1
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(1)).Name = "Other"
    wb.Worksheets("Other").Range("A1").Value = "other"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(2)).Name = "Third"
    wb.Worksheets("Third").Range("A1").Value = "third"
    wb.Worksheets("Other").Activate
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case name
        Case "first_csv": wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs path, xlCSV
        Case "active_csv": wb.Worksheets("Other").SaveAs path, xlCSV
        Case "third_text": wb.Worksheets("Third").SaveAs Filename:=path, FileFormat:=xlUnicodeText
        Case "first_xlsx": wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Case "no_format": wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs path
        Case "named_args": wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs Filename:=path, FileFormat:=xlCSV, Local:=True, AddToMru:=False, CreateBackup:=False
        Case "utf8": wb.Worksheets("Third").SaveAs path, xlCSVUTF8
        Case "msdos": wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs path, xlCSVMSDOS
        Case "hidden_sheet": wb.Worksheets("Third").Visible = xlSheetHidden: wb.Worksheets("Third").SaveAs path, xlCSV
    End Select
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = "error=" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description & "|"
    On Error GoTo 0
    s = s & Book(wb)
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
End Function
cases: wb.Worksheets("Data").SaveAs Filename:=path, FileFormat:=xlCSV, Local:=True, AddToMru:=False, CreateBackup:=False
